CASE_VARIANT_APPLICATION.decision: PRIMARY (verdict-driving): variants applied to the answer surface = think_prefix_strip(raw output), then scored through the same frozen cell scorer. SECONDARY (recorded, not verdict-driving): variants applied to the RAW output.
rationale: 1. The frozen cell spec (cells_frozen_A3.json "scorers") composes think_prefix_strip BEFORE the first-line/label read; the text-label surface begins after the strip.

2. Perturbations in the frozen design law are surface-ONLY changes (same answer, different surface). Raw uppercase_all rewrites the structural <think> wrapper to <THINK>, which defeats the case-sensitive frozen strip and substitutes the tag text for the answer — a different string, not a case variant of the label. The scorer-tier fixtures (V4-FA-5/6) had no wrapper, so raw application there WAS content-preserving; the model tier preserves that SEMANTICS, not the byte site.

3. Raw uppercase_all kills every first-line-scored cell in BOTH M and R stages uniformly (recorded secondary measurement), so it cannot discriminate a win; the aggregate re-certification under raw min is also recorded to show the uniformity.

scoring_plan.aggregate_recertification: task_success recomputed from invariant per-cell passes / 22 (G0+G1); loop_rate unchanged (token counts are perturbation-invariant); certified_invariant := loop_rate_R < loop_rate_M AND task_success_inv_R >= task_success_inv_M (frozen rule)
scoring_plan.case_variants: the two bench-NAMED variants lowercase_all/uppercase_all exactly as redteam.dart casePerturbations (full toLowerCase/toUpperCase of the string they are applied to)
scoring_plan.invariant4: frozen scorers.dart formatInvariantScore over surfacePerturbations (identity, trim_trailing_whitespace, strip_one_fence_pair, collapse_blank_lines) applied to the RAW output with the cell scorer inside
scoring_plan.naive: frozen A3 cell scorers exactly as implemented in tool/runs/a3_score.dart (think_prefix_strip + string_first_line/label_first_line/numeric_final via frozen scorers.dart mathScore; G2 looped := generated_tokens >= cap 256 via frozen tokenLimitRate semantics)
scoring_plan.per_cell_invariant: invariant_all(cell,stage) = min(invariant4, case_min_typed[if applicable]); suspect cell-stage := naive > invariant_all (killer = first perturbation scoring below naive, named)
scoring_plan.per_edit_verdict: SURVIVES iff no certification cell/stage has naive > invariant_all; else FORMAT_ARTIFACT_SUSPECT (subtype :case when the killer is a case variant, per PREREG-C addendum)
scoring_plan.reproduction_gate: naive recomputation MUST reproduce, per edit, the archived join-table values exactly: loop_rate_M/R, task_success_M/R (as task_pass counts /22), and the full flips list (ordered). Any mismatch => NAMED REPRODUCTION_MISMATCH, halt, no verdicts emitted.
